ctx.title: Former partners Nayanthara and Silambarasan TR to work together again for Dude director’s next film? Here’s what we know
ctx.summary:
Silambarasan TR and Nayanthara have made headlines together on several occasions over the years. Now, it seems that the former co-stars might reunite for the third time after several years in Dude director Keerthiswaran’s next film. 
 Nayanthara and STR to reunite for a 3rd time for Keerthiswaran directorial 
 According to several online media reports, including Movies Singapore,  Silambarasan TR  and Nayanthara are reportedly being considered for a new film. The upcoming movie is expected to be directed by Keerthiswaran and is likely to be an action entertainer featuring STR as a police officer. 
 However, this remains a report for now, and the makers have not made any official announcement regarding the casting. 
 Previously, STR and  Nayanthara  first shared screen space in Vallavan. The romantic thriller, written and directed by the actor himself, received mixed reviews and had a decent run at the box office before becoming a cult favourite among fans. 
 Later, the duo reunited for the romantic comedy Idhu Namma Aalu (2016). 
 Silambarasan TR and Nayanthara’s work front 
 Silambarasan TR was last seen alongside Kamal Haasan in Thug Life. Directed by Mani Ratnam, the film explores the evolving relationship between a veteran gangster and his foster son. The cast also includes Trisha Krishnan, Aishwarya Lekshmi, Abhirami, Ashok Selvan, Joju George, Nassar and Mahesh Manjrekar in pivotal roles. 
 Looking ahead, the actor will play the lead role in Arasan. Directed by Vetrimaa
